trailhead.label: Vnà, by the PostBus stop, the board’s start

cautions: A steep descent of 385 m in 2 km: take it slowly with older dogs.
A short stretch on the Ramosch–Vnà road: lead short and keep to the side.
Cows may graze the meadows near the farm: lead short and go round the herd.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Vnà to Ramosch on the old path: Da Vnà a Ramosch sul sentiero antico
textIt.Vnà, by the PostBus stop, the board’s st: Vnà, alla fermata dell’AutoPostale, la partenza della scheda ufficiale
textIt.A steep descent of 385 m in 2 km: take i: Una discesa ripida di 385 m in 2 km: con i cani anziani vai piano.
textIt.A short stretch on the Ramosch–Vnà road:: Un breve tratto sulla strada Ramosch–Vnà: guinzaglio corto e tieniti a lato.
textIt.Cows may graze the meadows near the farm: Le mucche possono pascolare nei prati vicino al maso: guinzaglio corto e aggira la mandria.
